description: Agent Bookkeeping: submit a payroll register with its ledger postings and pay schedule: the register with its reference, pay date, first and last day of the pay period, currency, whether the run is regular or off-cycle, each employee line with its id, the employee or employee number, gross pay, employee taxes withheld, other deductions and net pay, each employer tax line with its amount, and the register totals for gross, withholding, deductions, net and employer taxes; the postings with the posting date, currency and the gross wages, withholding, deductions, net pay and employer taxes posted to the ledger; the schedule with each regular pay date and each employer tax line every run carries. The signed report gives the register and the postings, each employee’s gross to net recomputed and each register total against its lines, each scheduled employer tax line found in the register, each register total against the total posted, and the pay date against the regular schedule, and counts them, and names a divergent register: gross-to-net arithmetic that does not recompute, an employer tax line missing from the run, and register totals unlike the posted totals; then an off-cycle run, another posting date and another currency, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No employee lines, no gross and net, no scheduled employer tax lines, no posted totals, or no pay schedule or run marking leaves those points unverified. Amounts compare to the cent in one currency and tax lines by their words; tax lines are read for presence against the schedule supplied and no tax is computed. This reads pay records: the Agent Hiring family checks hiring decisions and documents, from the brief to the contract and the payee setup, while the payroll check reads a payroll register against the ledger. Verdict bookkeeping_payroll_divergent, bookkeeping_payroll_partial, bookkeeping_payroll_unverified or bookkeeping_payroll_consistent. POST /api/bookkeeping-payroll-check. Reads the bookkeeping records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the books as supplied only: it never posts or edits an entry, never moves money or pays a bill, never files anything with any authority and gives no tax advice, which stay with the business, its bookkeeper and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Bookkeeping reads a business’s own books for internal consistency and against the records they should agree with: a general-ledger extract, a bank reconciliation, journal entries, a chart of accounts, a period close, the accounts payable ledger, a payroll register and the accounts receivable ledger, each against its own debits and credits, the source totals supplied, the bank statement and the ledger balance, the open period, the posting queue and recurring entries, or the ledger postings and pay schedule it should agree with. The family reads bookkeeping, the record a business keeps of its own transactions in its ledger and journals, and reads the records against each other. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-bookkeeping-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-bookkeeping/.
